source_snapshot.title: Dubai, Abu Dhabi police announce strategic drills on November 5
source_snapshot.text: Dubai and Abu Dhabi police will conduct separate strategic exercises on Thursday morning, November 5, with residents urged to stay away from the designated areas and avoid taking photographs or videos.Dubai Police said the exercise will take place at Dubai Sports City's Cricket Stadium at 9am, in collaboration with its strategic partners..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..In a post on X, the force urged community members to cooperate with authorities, keep away from the drill area and refrain from filming or photographing the exercise to ensure public safety.Abu Dhabi Police also announced an exercise at 9am on Thursday in Al Dhafra, in coordination with its partners..The force said the drill aims to assess readiness and strengthen response capabilities. Residents were asked not to approach the exercise location or take photographs.Both announcements advised the public to follow safety instructions and avoid the designated areas while the exercises are under way.

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: Dubai and Abu Dhabi police will conduct exercises on November 5.
The exercises will take place at 9:00 AM.
The Dubai exercise will be at the cricket stadium in Dubai Sports City.
The Abu Dhabi exercise will be in the Al Dhafra area.
Residents are asked not to approach the exercise locations or take photographs or videos.
Police urge residents to follow safety measures and cooperate with authorities during the exercises.

title: Dubai, Abu Dhabi police announce strategic drills on November 5
summary_ru: 🚓 Полиция Дубая и Абу-Даби проведёт учения 5 ноября 📅 Учения пройдут утром 5 ноября в 9:00: в Дубае на стадионе для крикета в Dubai Sports City, в Абу-Даби — в районе Аль-Дхафра. Жителей просят не приближаться к местам учений и не снимать происходящее. Полиция призывает соблюдать меры безопасности и сотрудничать с властями во время проведения учений.
